headline: Zoning variance requests for 7 Burnside Street, 31 Cedar Street, and 1-3 East Collins Street, plus a 75 North Street extension.
summary: Covers continued zoning requests for properties on Burnside Street and Cedar Street. Also includes an appeal at 1-3 East Collins Street and a six-month extension for a sixty-unit development at 75 North Street.
items: Continued: 7 Burnside Street and 5 Skerry Street Court, applicant Graham Wing (formerly Graham Hines). Variances to divide a merged parcel and build a two-family house at 5 Skerry Street Court, with five parking spaces where six are required.

Continued: 31 Cedar Street, applicants 31 Cedar Street, LLC and Salem Residential Rental Properties, LLC, through Michael Becker. Variances to separately develop two record parcels, keep the two-family dwelling at 31-33 Cedar Street, move the historic dwelling at 259 Washington Street to 27-29 Cedar Street, and build an addition to create a 2.5-story, two-family dwelling.

1-3 East Collins Street, applicant Charles Knight. Appeal of the Building Commissioner's decision to permit a building over thirty-five feet tall and a dumpster less than four feet from the abutting property line.

75 North Street, 2 Commercial Street, and 3 South Mason Street, applicant 75 North Street LLC. Six-month extension to rights granted in a decision dated December 11, 2023, for a sixty-unit, four-story mixed-use development.
Introduction of Associate Member Samantha Stringfellow.
Staff updates on application requirements and standard conditions.
Board vote on updated application requirements and standard conditions.

DOMINICK PANGALLO 
MAYOR 
     
CITY OF SALEM 
ZONING BOARD OF APPEALS 
 
CITY HALL ANNEX 2ND FLOOR, 98 WASHINGTON STREET, SALEM MA 01970 
 
 
1 
 
NOTICE OF MEETING 
 
Revised October 15, 2026 
 
Notice is given for a Zoning Board of Appeals open public meeting held remotely on 
October 21, 2026, at 6:30pm. The City is authorized to conduct remote meetings of 
its public bodies through special acts of the Massachusetts State Legislature. 
   
Nina Vyedin, Chair   
 
Important Announcement:    
Every effort will be made to ensure that the public can adequately access the proceedings 
in real time, via technological means. If we are unable to do so on matters not requiring 
a public hearing, we will post on the City of Salem’s website an audio or video recording, 
transcript, or other comprehensive record of proceedings after the meeting. 
 
Individuals may participate remotely using a remote participation platform called Zoom. 
Members of the public can access the remote meeting in any of the following ways:    
   
Attending the Virtual Public Meeting:    
• Go to Website link: 
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83427530365?pwd=GqYiOJHxKonVjQUFuWQgPfRiqV4Mh2.1
or go to the website link https://zoom.us/join and enter the meeting ID #834 
2753 0365 followed by meeting password 011324 if directed to do so on 
screen.     
• Dial toll-free phone number 877-853-5257. When prompted enter meeting ID 
#834 2753 0365 followed by meeting password 011324 if directed. Those 
calling in will not have access to the direct video feed of the meeting but can 
follow along with the project materials available for 
download at https://www.salemma.gov/877/Zoning-Board-of-Appeals.   
• Watch the meeting live on Salem Access Television Chanel 22.    
• Project materials are available for download at https://tinyurl.com/SalemZBA.  
 
Providing Public Comment Before the Meeting:    
Members of the public can email their comment s before the start of the meeting 
to zoningboardcomments@salem.com.         
 
Providing Public Comment During the Meeting:
City of Salem Zoning Board of Appeals 
October 21, 2026 Agenda 
Know your rights under the Open Meeting Law M.G.L. c. 30A § 18-25 and City Ordinance § 2-
2028 through § 2-2033. 
 
2 
 
Members of the public attending this meeting virtually will be allowed to make comments 
when the Chair opens the hearing for public comments. Members of the public will be 
asked to use the virtual “Raise Hand” function in Zoom to indicate that they would like to 
provide comment. 
• Dial *9 on your phone’s dial pad to raise your hand if you are using the toll-free 
number. 
• Click the “Raise Hand” button if you are using the Zoom application on your 
computer or phone.    
 
For each agenda item, the moderator will identify attendees with raised hands by their 
screenname. Phone numbers are ordered first, followed by an alphabetical list of the 
screen names of attendees accessing Zoom through a computer, tablet, or smartphone. 
       
Familiarizing Yourself with Zoom:    
We encourage members of the public to install and familiarize themselves with Zoom 
before the meeting. The Zoom meeting will open fifteen minutes before the start of the 
meeting to allow participants to connect and practice with the audio and raise hand 
functions.  
    
If you plan on providing public comments and are logging into this meeting via the Zoom 
application, please test your speakers and microphone ahead of time. If we have trouble 
hearing you when you speak, we will move on to the next person and try to return to you 
later in the list. If this happens, we recommend that you call the toll -free number to 
access the meeting and provide your comment. 
 
People requiring auxiliary aids and services for effective communication such as sign 
language interpreter, an assistive listening device, or print material in digital format or a 
reasonable modification in programs, services, policies, or activities, may contact the City 
of Salem ADA Coordinator as soon as possible and no less than two business days before 
the meeting, program, or event.
City of Salem Zoning Board of Appeals 
October 21, 2026 Agenda 
Know your rights under the Open Meeting Law M.G.L. c. 30A § 18-25 and City Ordinance § 2-
2028 through § 2-2033. 
 
3 
 
MEETING AGENDA   
   
I. ROLL CALL  
 
II. CONTINUANCES 
 
1. Location: 7 Burnside Street and 5 Skerry Street Court (R2 Zoning District) 
Applicant: Graham Wing (formerly Graham Hines) 
Description: The petition of GRAHAM WING (formerly Graham Hines) at 7 
BURNSIDE STREET and 5 SKERRY STREET COURT (Map 36, Lot 0157; Map 36, 
Lot 0149) (R2 Zoning District) for Variances per Section 4.1.1 Dimensional 
Requirements and Section 5.1.8 Required Parking of the Salem Zoning Ordinance 
to divide an existing merged parcel and construct a two -family house at 5 Skerry 
Street Court, with five parking spaces where six spaces are required. The proposal 
would create a 4,393-square-foot lot at 7 Burnside Street with a 2,196-square-foot 
lot area per dwelling unit and two parking spaces, and a 3,820 -square-foot lot at 
5 Skerry Street Court with a 1,910 -square-foot lot area per dwellin g unit, three 
parking spaces, a thirty-seven-foot frontage, and insufficient front, side, and rear 
setbacks. 
 
2. Location: 31 Cedar Street (R2 Zoning District) 
Applicant: 31 Cedar Street, LLC and Salem Residential Properties, LLC, through 
Michael Becker 
Description: The petition of 31 CEDAR STREET, LLC and SALEM RESIDENTIAL 
RENTAL PROPERTIES, LLC, through MICHAEL BECKER, at 31 CEDAR STREET (Map 
34, Lot 0052) (R2 Zoning District) for Variances per Section 3.2.4(3) Accessory 
Structures, Section 4.1.1 Dimensional Requirements, and Section 5.1.6(2) Parking 
Setbacks of the Salem Zoning Ordinance to permit the separate development of 
two existing record parcels; retain the existing two-family dwelling at 31-33 Cedar 
Street; and relocate the historic dwelling at 259 Washington Street to 27-29 Cedar 
Street, retain the existing garage, and construct an addition to create a 2.5-story, 
two-family dwelling. Relief under Section 4.1.1 is requested for lot frontage, lot 
width, lot area, lot area per dwelling unit, lot coverage, and front and side setbacks 
on both parcels. Relie f under Section 3.2.4(3) is requested for the side and rear 
setbacks of the existing detached accessory garage on 27-29 Cedar Street. Relief 
under Section 5.1.6(2) is requested to allow the surfaced shared driveway and 
parking-access areas to extend to the common lot line. 
 
III. REGULAR AGENDA 
 
3. Location: 1-3 East Collins Street (R1 Zoning District; Coastal Resiliency Overlay 
District) 
Applicant: Charles Knight
City of Salem Zoning Board of Appeals 
October 21, 2026 Agenda 
Know your rights under the Open Meeting Law M.G.L. c. 30A § 18-25 and City Ordinance § 2-
2028 through § 2-2033. 
 
4 
 
Description: The petition of CHARLES KNIGHT regarding the property located at 
1-3 EAST COLLINS STREET (Map 36, Lot 0277) (R1 Zoning District; Coastal 
Resiliency Overlay District) to appeal the Building Commissioner’s decision to 
permit a building over thirty -five feet tall, and a dumpster located less than four 
feet from the abutting property line. 
 
IV. OLD/NEW BUSINESS 
 
1. Location: 75 North Street, 2 Commercial Street, and 3 South Mason Street (North 
River Canal Corridor Neighborhood Mixed Use District; Coastal Resiliency Overlay 
District) 
Applicant: 75 North Street LLC 
Description: The petition of 75 NORTH STREET LLC at 75 NORTH STR EET, 2 
COMMERCIAL STREET, and 3 SOUTH MASON STREET (Map 26, Lot 0058; Map 26, 
Lot 0057; Map 26, Lot 0054) (North River Canal Corridor Neighborhood Mixed Use 
District; Coastal Resiliency Overlay District) for a six-month extension to rights 
granted by the Board in a decision dated December 11, 2023, for Variances per 
Section 4.1.1 Dimensional Requirements, Section 8.4.9 and 8.4.9(c) Parking 
Requirements, and Section 8.4.13(4) Transitional Overlay District to construct a 
sixty-unit, four-story, mixed-use development with relief requested for lot area per 
dwelling unit, one-to-one parking ratio s, and 100-foot and fifty-foot buffer 
entrance and landscaping requirements. 
 
2. Introductions for Associate Member Samantha Stringfellow. 
 
3. Staff updates on the Board’s application requirements and standard conditions. 
 
4. Board vote on updated application requirements and standard conditions. 
 
V. APPROVAL OF MINUTES 
 
1. Draft minutes from September 9, 2026. 
 
2. Draft minutes from September 16, 2026. 
 
VI. ADJOURNMENT 
 
This agenda is subject to change.
